diagram_previews.alt: Side view of the can tilted 45 degrees from the vertical, with height 12 and width 6; the shaded soda lies below the horizontal surface z = x + 11, which touches the rim of the hole at the red point X, and the hole is a gap in the top.

difficulty_rationale: Modelling the tilted surface, noticing that the lid cuts off part of the liquid on the lowered side, and integrating over a circular segment combine familiar ideas in a moderately demanding way.
